privacy.meta_description: Privacy Policy for Pulse Flow Ops: how we handle account and operations data.
privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.updated: Pulse Flow Ops · Last updated: 27 August 2026
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how Pulse Flow Ops collects, uses, and shares information when you use pulseflow.site, app.pulseflow.site, and related services (the “Service”).
privacy.s1_li1: Account data: name, email, role, organization, and authentication identifiers.
privacy.s1_li2: Operations data: properties, tasks, contacts, messages, service orders, bills, endorsements, notifications, and related metadata.
privacy.s1_li3: Files: property photos and receipt images you upload.
privacy.s1_li4: Billing data: when company billing is enabled, Stripe processes card details. We store Stripe customer and subscription IDs, not full card numbers.
privacy.s1_li5: Referral data: referral codes, invite links, and join records used to track referral rewards.
privacy.s1_li6: Technical data: device/browser type, IP address, and basic usage logs needed to secure and operate the Service.
privacy.s2_li1: Provide and improve rental operations features
privacy.s2_li2: Authenticate users and enforce organization roles
privacy.s2_li4: Process company subscriptions and referral rewards when billing is active
privacy.s2_li5: Respond to support requests and legal obligations
privacy.s2_no_sell: We do not sell your personal information.
privacy.s3_intro: We share data only as needed with:
privacy.s3_li1: Infrastructure providers (hosting, database, storage, auth) that process data on our instructions
privacy.s3_li2: Stripe for company payments when billing is enabled
privacy.s3_li3: Your organization: teammates you invite can see data according to their role
privacy.s3_li4: Authorities when required by law or to protect the Service and users
privacy.s4_body: We retain account and operations data while your organization is active and for a reasonable period afterward for backups, disputes, and legal compliance. You may request deletion of your account; some records may remain where required by law (for example billing history).
privacy.s5_body: We use industry-standard safeguards. No method of transmission or storage is 100% secure; use strong passwords and limit who you invite.
privacy.s6_li1: Update profile and organization settings in the app
privacy.s6_li2: Manage or cancel company billing via the billing portal when available
privacy.s6_li3: Contact us to access, correct, or delete personal data where applicable
privacy.s7_body: The Service may be hosted in regions chosen by our providers. If you use Pulse Flow Ops from another country, your information may be processed outside your home jurisdiction.
privacy.s8_body: The Service is for business operations and is not directed at children under 16. We do not knowingly collect data from children.
privacy.s9_body: We may update this Policy and will post the new version with a revised date. Continued use after changes means you accept the updated Policy.
privacy.s10_body: Privacy questions: support@pulseflow.site. See also our Terms of Service.
